morbi.headline: Morbi faces severe export contraction alongside recurring domestic trade credit defaults and fraud.
what_changed: India's ceramic tile export volumes plunged 46% during April-July 2026, leading to a weak full-year FY27 export outlook.
Multiple buyer fraud incidents emerged, exposing manufacturers to unsecured trade credit defaults in the domestic market.
stress_signals: Export volumes dropped 46% year-on-year in Apr-Jul 2026, severely dampening the FY27 demand outlook for ceramic tile makers [434975bd08e0].
A Mumbai-based buyer allegedly defrauded a Morbi ceramic unit of Rs 44 lakh after procuring tiles on credit [e694c857f915].
A buyer absconded after securing 7,865 ceramic tile boxes on credit, reflecting recurring unsecured payment defaults in the cluster [76fdd3301f32].
what_to_watch: Full-year FY27 export trajectory and subsequent export volume prints following the 46% drop in Apr-Jul 2026.
Elongation of debtor collection cycles and rising non-payment/fraud risks on unsecured domestic credit sales.
Working capital utilization and cash flow stress in export-focused tile manufacturing units facing volume drops.

surat.headline: Surat faces labor unrest, embroidery impasse, yarn cost shocks, and declining diamond exports.
what_changed: Textile loom units face early pre-Diwali closures driven by a ₹50/kg yarn price hike.
Embroidery segment enters its third month of operational impasse amidst severe labor protests and detentions.
Polished diamond exports dropped 7%, alongside regulatory scrutiny in the UK over LGD advertising.
GST Council offered relief via Input Tax Credit refunds and reduced highway checks for textiles.
stress_signals: Surat loom units consider early Diwali closure due to a ₹50/kg yarn price spike [b567711c9ed4].
Embroidery sector faces a three-month operational deadlock, labor strikes, and worker detentions [e7921383cbb7, 7697e96a190e, 29331b975c9e].
Polished diamond shipments dropped 7%, with localized wage defaults reported in processing [975918f112f3, 698c779932f2].
Trade defaults and fraud reported in grey fabric and textile trading amounting to ₹10.43 crore combined [2514ad7d6e20, c4997bb35d98].
improvement_signals: GST Council approved Input Tax Credit (ITC) refunds and streamlined highway checks for textiles [17f0a015a73c].
Textile manufacturers are diversifying capacity into defence technical textiles [94bf5c2693d4].
Bridal demand for lab-grown diamonds is shifting toward larger stone sizes [694aea903d0a].
what_to_watch: Machine-loan servicing ability and cash velocity among embroidery job-work units amidst ongoing labor distress.
Capacity utilization and working capital limits of weaving units managing yarn price increases via FOB rates.
Export order books for diamond manufacturers following UK regulatory warnings on lab-grown diamond advertising.
Impact of migrant labor reverse migration on post-festive textile cluster operational capacity.
